description: Returns a ballpark monthly range in USD for a full-time (or part-time) remote hire through Hire Overseas for a role, from the Hire Overseas rate card, adjusted by real placement data for the region when there is enough of it. A range for the role, not the price of any candidate. Hire Overseas works within the client's budget; the exact rate is confirmed on a short call (bookACall).

ai_heavy.description: true when the role needs strong AI / automation skills (e.g. building with Claude, n8n, Zapier) on top of the base role

hours.description: full_time (default, about 40 hours a week) or part_time

region.description: Where the hire would be based: ph (Philippines), latam (Latin America) or africa. Omit for any region.

role.description: Job title or a few words about the role, e.g. 'Executive Assistant' or 'SDR for a SaaS startup'

seniority.description: Experience level: junior (about 0-2 years), mid (3-5) or senior (6+). Omit if unknown.

name: salary_benchmark
title: Ballpark monthly cost of an overseas hire
